This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website or use our services (Hotels, Airlines, and Tour & Travel).
privacyPage.dataDesc: We collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when submitting contact inquiries or subscribing to our newsletters. This includes:
privacyPage.dataList5: Any message content you send to us
privacyPage.useDesc: We process your personal information to fulfill our services and respond to inquiries, specifically to:
privacyPage.useList1: Contact you regarding booking, aviation charters, or pilgrim services.
privacyPage.useList2: Send periodic newsletters and updates if you have opted in.
